src/agent_runtime/api/init.py

Python · Tier A

Separate running API identity from the current checkout identity.

Responsibilities

  • Expose package, startup and current Git-derived runtime version metadata for API/CLI consumers.

Boundaries

  • Runtime identity is not public branding or a unified version for all services; source inspection never changes Git state.

Lifecycle

  • Capture startup metadata lazily, reuse it for running identity and obtain fresh snapshots only for update-status comparisons.

State

  • Module startup snapshot and small lru_cache entries retain process identity; returned dictionaries protect cached state from caller mutation.

Security

  • Git commands use argument vectors and read-only inspection. Missing/failed Git falls back rather than requiring repository access to start.

Collaborators

  • model_identity.py retains compatibility aliases; API/CLI status consumers compare running and current Git hashes.

Public surface

  • get_runtime_version_info, get_current_runtime_version_info and get_runtime_version_update_status distinguish restart advice from a version rename.

@see docs/engineering/configuration-catalog.md

src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/conversation_abandonment.py

Python · Tier A

Retire unresolved conversation work while preserving its execution evidence.

Responsibilities

  • Write abandonment/tombstone transitions in the caller's management transaction and notify existing cancellation owners afterward.

Boundaries

  • Abandonment does not erase uncertain receipts or assert that remote jobs were cancelled successfully.

Lifecycle

  • abandon_in returns cancellation targets after marking owned runs/tasks; signal_cancellation clears private conversation resources and requests existing local/Gateway stops.

State

  • The management transaction owns durable changes. Cancellation notifications may continue on a daemon thread while retained receipts remain authoritative.

Security

  • Closed conversations cannot re-register volatile resources; private values are discarded and Gateway scopes invalidated through their registered owners.

Collaborators

  • conversation_management.py commits deletion; current_run/native_store.py preserves journals/receipts; native/conversation_resources.py clears credential and binding lifetime.

Public surface

  • abandon_in requires the caller's attached transaction; signal_cancellation is called after commit and tolerates unreachable cancellation transports.

@see src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/conversation_management.py

@see src/agent_runtime/native/conversation_resources.py

src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/conversation_management.py

Python · Tier A

Project conversation management and dispatch reviewed deletion to its state owner.

Responsibilities

Resolve selections, inspect blockers, bind preview digests and coordinate metadata/search/activity/deletion across conversation, task and run owners.

Boundaries

Active-controller deletion records durable intent for background collection; standalone SQLite stores retain synchronous deletion. Neither path proves remote work stopped.

Lifecycle

Preview reads current facts. Delete rechecks the selection and, for protected deletion, safety. Explicit abandonment binds identities rather than a frozen work snapshot. Running-filter membership is resolved before pagination; optional activity adds no mutation.

State

RAM operations delegate to memory_conversation_management and its shared hub. Only the standalone branch reserves attached SQLite databases and releases resources after commit.

Security

Preview hashes compare freshness, not authority. Unresolved work requires explicit abandonment; independent objects and execution evidence keep their ownership rules.

Collaborators

memory_conversation_management queues collection; conversation_gc owns eventual cleanup; conversation_abandonment supplies standalone transitions and cancellation signals.

Public surface

ConversationManagementService.query/index/patch/preview/delete and strict metadata, selection and deletion models serve the conversation HTTP routes.

@see src/agent_runtime/runtime_state/conversation_gc.py

Python · Tier A

HTTP routes own validation envelopes and post-commit wake/publication; these helpers perform no model or Gateway work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

  • OAuth and approval interactions use their protocol controls. UI gating and display metadata are not substitutes for server checks or redaction.

Loaded first in <head> on every SMTO page, so no other script runs in an unsupported browser: every later script is disarmed and the parsed page is replaced by the notice. Only desktop Safari is blocked. On iPhone and iPad every browser runs WebKit, and the phone UI and certificate setup rely on it, so iOS stays supported; iPadOS Safari reports a Mac user agent, which touch support tells apart. The renderer is vendored in mermaid_vendor/ (frontend/mermaid/build.mjs) and imported only when a diagram is first shown; it makes no network requests of its own. JavaScript · Tier A

Render shared message clocks and one accessible timestamp-details popup for desktop/mobile views. Bind accepted send, first visible reply and retained completion/activity timestamps without inventing unknown dates. Transcript grouping keeps repeated speaker labels compact; one popup timer and one local-midnight timer serve the page, while callers own per-turn binding disposal.

src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/mobile/api.js

JavaScript · Tier A

Supply mobile presentation state, scoped draft persistence and JSON transport.

Responsibilities

Share the mobile page's view state, inert DOM/error helpers and read client; preserve unsent text and capability selections across navigation.

Boundaries

app.js owns navigation and submission. Server endpoints validate task, permission and capability authority; local draft choices are only composer input.

Lifecycle

Module initialization loads the mobile error presenter and one page-lived capability-draft listener. Input debounces storage writes; navigation/page callbacks flush captured drafts and accepted submissions consume only matching text.

State

One mutable presentation object, one pending draft/timer and namespaced localStorage. Pending text keeps its original conversation scope through navigation; storage errors are tolerated and restored capability choices are shape-checked.

Security

Text uses textContent. Links permit HTTP(S); rendered images additionally require existing same-origin file/artifact routes. JSON transport keeps same-origin credentials; storage is browser-local persistence, not a secret or approval store.

Collaborators

errors.js owns transport/error rendering; conversation_snapshot.js coalesces eligible reads; overlays.js loads on demand for notice details.

Public surface

state/storage, DOM and URL helpers, api, draft and appearance helpers. Custom headers, cancellation signals and writes bypass shared read coalescing.

paint(root, draw) runs the owner's own paint (a full Markdown re-render, or appending to a text node) and wraps only the text the root gained in a fading span. Details

A turn's live prose is shown in one of two places: its work timeline (narration groups) or its own message flow (plan, progress and answer messages). Cards go into whichever of the two is visible, ordered by time among that prose: a decision starts before the narration it produces and a step starts after it, so each decision's thinking leads its narration and each step's IN / OUT follows. Cards never go below the start of the final answer, and if the visible prose moves to the other place mid-run, the turn's cards move with it.

Turns without live rows (saved turns, or a run already under way when the page opened) are filled from the recorded trace with the shared timing reducer; while such a run is still going the trace is read again every few seconds so new decisions and steps appear live. Read-only: card text is rendered by the card owners with textContent.

Share desktop invalidations while tracking whether critical snapshots are current.

Responsibilities

Coalesce topic notifications, fan out reads and distinguish transport connection from completed authoritative reconciliation.

Boundaries

Events carry invalidation hints, never run state or permission decisions. Subscribers own HTTP reads, navigation scope and DOM updates; mobile owns its own transport.

Lifecycle

Install once per page, open one update EventSource, reconcile on connection, then batch events. Critical read failures have three bounded retries, not idle polling.

State

Page-local subscribers, dirty topics, timers and connection epoch. Disconnects invalidate freshness; late promises cannot mark a newer epoch current. CLOSED streams are replaced with backoff; CONNECTING streams retain the browser's native reconnect.

Security

Snapshot owners must revalidate server truth before enabling controls. IDs and reasons on the update bus are diagnostics, not execution authority or private payloads.

Collaborators

update_stream.py publishes committed invalidations; conversation_snapshot.js delays optional reads; native_controls.js and other subscribers determine critical read success.

Public surface

SMTOUiUpdates exposes subscribe/unsubscribe, state, freshness, observeFreshness/unsubscribe and reconcile. Global listeners live for the page lifetime.
